author: Dave Love SketchFab / Tyler_Dave
coordinateSystem: metres; +Y up, +Z forward, +X driver left; y=0 tyre bottom
geometrySplit: triangle centroid inspection regions; not factory component seams; wheel-only source materials split per corner

fidelity.reason: No factory CAD, point cloud or calibrated multi-view references. Target is not a measured result.

limits: Exact race/upgrade specification is unspecified by asset author.
Scale is uniform normalization to a 1.90 m reference width, not measured RB22 size.
Source bottom surfaces are retained; hidden internal structures are not reconstructed.
No FIA full geometry compliance claim.
Wheel rotation and steering are inspection demonstrations, not vehicle dynamics.
